Preference
Preference may be given to applicants who:
intending to enrol or currently enrolled in a PhD,
have not previously received an Australian Government or University Scholarship to complete an HDR course at the same level,
have not previously completed an HDR course at the same level of study.
How to apply
To be considered for a RTP scholarship and equivalent University scholarships, you must:
Commencing students
Apply for admission and submit all required documentation for admission to a higher degree by research through Sydney Courses by the deadlines outlined in the 'Application and award timeline' table – these differ for domestic students and international students.
Submit the scholarship application form by the deadlines.
Currently enrolled students
Be currently enrolled in a higher degree by research.
Submit the scholarship application form by the deadlines.
